groups.name: mica
groups.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 16-bit pixel sprite sheet. Reference 1 is four native Super Sonic running poses rendered in their real game palettes at 8x, LEFT TO RIGHT S2 phase0, S2 phase1, S3K phase0, S3K phase1. Reference 2 is approved MICA pangolin model sheet: use GOLD form and compact round scale plates, never quills. Draw exactly FOUR separate Gilded MICA sprites in one horizontal row, one corresponding to each native pose. Native pose is a forward suspended sprint: head at right, slim horizontal torso, both arms streaming straight back left, red boots swept back, one boot slightly higher per phase. Keep one fixed head and torso scale and face direction across ALL four drawings, head about 13 native px, torso9, total native bbox ~40x32 including tail. Rounded overlapping gold pangolin scales and long tapering scaled tail stream left, pale gold cream snout/belly, small pink ear, brown eye, white gloves, coral red boots with tan soles. Follow exact native contact/limb phases. S2 style simple 3-tone cel pixel clusters; S3K native slightly richer material-shadow pixel clusters, upper-left highlights, NO thick all-black sticker outlines, NO dither, NO gradients. At most15 colors each, hard-edged pixels intended for ~40px sprite. All anatomy coherent, no separate floating boots or gloves, no glow, text, labels, shadow or floor. Equal 300x300 cells in a 1200x300 transparent sheet with padding, all sprites complete.
